state_definitions.manual-required: The public first-party pages establish the feature but the authorized 5.1.1 manual/examples are required before native input or execution can be specified.
state_definitions.design-only: The provider advertises the route, but this Skill has no provider-specific parent contract or real forward fixture.
state_definitions.repository-guard: The command is a local deterministic repository tool that never launches LOBSTER.
state_definitions.companion-official-recipe: The call is documented by the developer-authored LobsterPy companion project and applies only to postprocessing existing artifacts.
state_definitions.local-handoff: The workflow composes repository Skills and evidence contracts; it is not a native LOBSTER command or active route.

recipes.title: Prepare a VASP parent for LOBSTER 5.1.1
inputs: structure, k-point, settings, potential-metadata, wavefunction, and validation hashes
outputs: provider-specific private input bundle outside Git
units_and_semantics: parent structure, spin/SOC, k-point weights, functional, potentials, band count, energy window, and wavefunction must refer to one run lineage
scientific_checks: occupied and requested unoccupied band coverage
failure_modes: different k mesh or band count
community defaults substituted for the 5.1.1 manual

recipes.title: Prepare a Quantum ESPRESSO parent for LOBSTER 5.1.1
inputs: reviewed complete QE SCF wavefunction/save source
QE version, pseudopotential, structure, k-point, spin/SOC, band, wavefunction, and validation hashes
outputs: future provider-specific private input bundle outside Git
units_and_semantics: the first-party LOBSTER page advertises QE support but does not publish exact supported versions, wavefunction files, pseudopotential classes, or conversion settings
failure_modes: assuming every QE release or pseudopotential works
using the synthetic VASP profile as QE evidence

recipes.title: Launch LOBSTER 5.1.1 on a prepared parent
outputs: execution record with hashes and separate process/scientific states
units_and_semantics: exact executable filename, argv, working-directory contract, completion marker, and output schema are not stated on public first-party pages

recipes.title: Request and validate projected COHP evidence
outputs: version-bound COHP curves and integrated interaction list
units_and_semantics: COHP partitions band-structure energy
COHP and plotted -COHP have opposite signs
integrals require an explicit energy window/reference and do not equal total bond energy
failure_modes: curve and integral from different windows
low spilling used as the only validity test

recipes.title: Request and validate projected COOP evidence
outputs: version-bound COOP curves and integrated interaction list
units_and_semantics: COOP partitions electron number rather than band energy
integrated COOP and ICOHP are not interchangeable

recipes.title: Request and validate crystal orbital bond-index evidence
inputs: explicit two- or multi-center interaction definition
outputs: version-bound COBI curves and integrated interaction list
units_and_semantics: COBI is an energy-resolved solid-state bond-index descriptor
ICOBI interpretation depends on basis, center definition, spin, and integration window
ICOBI is not an automatic unique experimental bond order
failure_modes: COBI confused with COHP or COOP
manual syntax inferred from a public parser

recipes.title: Request and validate projected density of states
units_and_semantics: DOS locates electronic states; it does not supply bonding character by itself
total/projected closure requires explicit normalization and channel semantics

recipes.title: Request and validate orbital populations, charges, and optional site-potential evidence
units_and_semantics: Mulliken and Loewdin values are basis-partitioned descriptors
site potentials and Madelung energies require a declared Ewald/charge convention
none is an automatic oxidation-state or total-energy decomposition
scientific_checks: Ewald convention and units when applicable

recipes.title: Audit a declarative LOBSTER evidence package
units_and_semantics: a pass is synthetic/local gate evidence only and carries no positive scientific claim
failure_modes: native artifacts presented as JSON interchange
synthetic parser pass treated as 5.1.1 parser validation
shared route inferred from development source

recipes.title: Describe existing LOBSTER COHP/COOP/COBI artifacts with LobsterPy
calls: lobsterpy description -fcharge CHARGE.lobster -fcohp COHPCAR.lobster -ficohp ICOHPLIST.lobster -fstruct POSCAR.lobster -fjson summary.json
units_and_semantics: use --coops or --cobis only with matching artifacts
automatic cutoffs and cation/anion classification are analysis choices and must be recorded
scientific_checks: native package already passed projection/task gates
failure_modes: companion parse success treated as native validity
interactions absent from original LOBSTER run
automated description promoted to expert conclusion

recipes.title: Hand validated LOBSTER curves and tables to dft-postprocess
inputs: normalized arrays with labels, units, references, selectors, spin/sign conventions, and parser identity
units_and_semantics: raw COHP versus -COHP, COOP/COBI quantity, integrated window, Fermi zero, spin channels, and atom/orbital selectors remain explicit
scientific_checks: no silent interpolation or sign inversion
failure_modes: postprocessor repairs or hides projection failure
curve sign changed only in labels

recipes.title: Review a comparative integrated-COHP claim
units_and_semantics: integrated COHP hints toward interaction strength but partitions one-particle band energy rather than total energy
scientific_checks: same integration window and Fermi convention
failure_modes: different coordination or bond multiplicity ignored
stability inferred from one pair interaction
